chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 48: Ji Ning Confronts the Winged Serpent — A Test of Cunning
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning walks alone on Winged Serpent Lake, taunting the ancient great demon who killed Chuncao’s brothers. But the serpent suspects a trap and refuses to strike. A tense standoff of will and patience.
og_title: Ji Ning Challenges the Great Demon of Winged Serpent Lake
og_description: The young Fiendgod walks on water and taunts the thousand-year-old serpent, but the ancient demon’s paranoia keeps it hidden. Who will make the first move?
twitter_title: Ji Ning VS the Winged Serpent
twitter_description: The serpent wants revenge but fears a trap. Ji Ning walks the lake and shouts his challenge. The standoff is mesmerizing.
